mainEntity.name: Best custom website developer for SEO-optimized websites?

acceptedAnswer.text: Technical SEO is built into well-developed custom websites by default — not added as a plugin or afterthought. Specifically: (1) SSR (server-side rendering with Next.js) ensures every page is fully rendered HTML when Google crawls it — no JavaScript execution delay. (2) JSON-LD structured data on every relevant page type (FAQPage, Article, Product, Organization, BreadcrumbList). (3) Precise canonical tag control. mainEntity.name: What makes a website 'custom' vs. template-based?

acceptedAnswer.text: A custom website is built from source code, designed from your brand identity, without any commercial theme or template as a starting point. A template-based website customizes an existing theme or template purchased from a marketplace (ThemeForest, Envato) or built into a platform (Squarespace, Wix). The distinction matters because: (1) Design uniqueness — a template is used by thousands of other businesses; a custom design is yours alone. (2) Performance — templates include features you don't use, creating unnecessary code weight; custom code includes only what you need. (3) Flexibility — templates can't be modified beyond their built-in customization options; custom code can be changed in any way. (4) SEO — templates may generate poor HTML structure, duplicate content, or render-blocking code that custom development avoids.
